lines.text: A very modern spy novel set in London, where the Americans are pitted against the Brits (and maybe other Americans?). Chief of Station Artemis Proctor is no political lackey. A rough talking (shocking the Brits) rule breaker, she gets stuff done in a way that might raise eyebrows, but is immensely effective.
